# The resource timeline example opens on a plan, and gets its card

## Context

`examples/timeline/basic` shows the timeline column in a plain grid: "a time axis in any grid", as #21140's target names its card in Grid & Table, cross-listed in Scheduler. The engine side landed with #20890. The record `timeline-basic` exists and has no cover, so it publishes no card (#21890).

## The Problem

Ada's read of its landing frame on `dev` `50fcfc526c` ([her comment](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21890#issuecomment-7078965758) on #21890): the example opens on an empty grid from 00:00 to 06:00, dated Mon, Nov 16, on Neo Light. A visitor who reaches it sees no bar. There is nothing to capture, and the dated start will be further off every day.

## The Architectural Reality

- `examples/timeline/basic`; since 16 Nov the folder gained only the theme switcher.
- The record `timeline-basic`: family `grid-table`, `alsoIn: ['scheduler']`, no `image`.
- A cover is the frame a visitor lands on (#21140): the bars have to be in view when the example opens.

## The Fix

The example opens on a believable plan with bars in view: a handful of resources and bookings generated relative to today, the axis starting where the first booking is. It takes its start theme from the catalog's link. One line says what the example proves: a time axis is a column, and the rest is a grid. The cover is that first frame, which publishes the card in Grid & Table and in Scheduler.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] On open, bookings are visible without scrolling, and their dates are relative to today.
- [ ] Opened from the dark catalog the example is dark.
- [ ] One line on the first frame says what it proves.
- [ ] No console error, at 1440×900 and at 390×844.
- [ ] The record carries a cover from the first frame at 960 × 540 (through `neomjs/pages`); the card shows in Grid & Table and in Scheduler.
- [ ] The look: the first frame at both sizes, Neo Dark, on the pull request.

**Publication (added 22 Nov, the same for every leaf of this wave).** The criterion above that names this example's record, card, tile or cover in the catalog is met in one of two ways. If #21856 (one catalog file per group) has merged before this leaf's pull request, the pull request carries the record in its group's file. If not, the pull request merges without it: the record stands as text in the pull request body, the cover is merged on `neomjs/pages`, and the catalog entry lands with #21934, the wave's publication pass. Either way this leaf closes with its example.

## Out of Scope

Changes to `src/timeline`. Scheduler features: this example stays a grid with one time column.
